name: Behavioral Blending
description: The most reliable evasion technique is not avoiding cameras — it is not triggering a human response when seen on camera or in person. Moving at a purposeful, unhurried pace appropriate to the cover role, avoiding lingering or searching behaviors, maintaining appropriate eye contact with staff, and responding naturally to challenges are all components of behavioral blending. An operator who looks like they belong will be ignored even on recorded footage.

blue.det: Difficult to detect in real time; post-incident review of footage may reveal operator; behavioral analytics on extended presence without purpose.
blue.cm: Behavioral analytics systems; security staff training on anomalous behavior detection; challenge culture empowering staff to verify identity of anyone lingering without clear purpose.
